create_QoQConfig: create a QoQConfig instance with weight_bits=4 and group_size=-1 for per-channel quantization
build_QoQLinearMethod: build a QoQLinearMethod from a QoQConfig to apply 4-bit weight quantization with per-token activation quantization
create_QoQLinearMethod_weights: create quantized layer weights (qweight, s1_scales, s1_szeros or s2_scales/s2_zeros) for a QoQ linear layer
process_QoQLinearMethod_weights: process QoQ layer weights after loading by wrapping them as Parameters with requires_grad=False
run_QoQLinearMethod_apply: run a QoQ quantized forward pass using per-channel or per-group w4a8 GEMM with float16 input
